analyses.name: Matrix Multiplication Optimization

complexity.explanation: Quadratic complexity O(n²): 2 nested loops iterating over n.

findings.explanation: Avoid streaming to std::cout in hot loops.
findings.suggestion: Buffer output or log via structured logger.

aiReview.summary: Quadratic computation routine detected with minor I/O latency smell.

optimizations.title: Vectorize inner loop with SIMD
optimizations.description: Pre-allocate output array and utilize compiler vectorization.

analyses.name: Authentication Dispatcher Service

complexity.explanation: Linear control flow executing in constant time.

findings.explanation: `eval()` executes untrusted strings as code in the application privilege context.
findings.suggestion: Use jsonwebtoken library to verify signature without eval.

findings.message: Empty catch block silently swallowing exceptions
findings.explanation: Exceptions during token parsing are lost without trace.
findings.suggestion: Log the error or reject the promise.

aiReview.summary: Critical security vulnerability: dangerous eval statement discovered in auth path.

securityRisks.name: Arbitrary Code Execution via eval()

securityRisks.mitigation: Remove eval and use standard cryptographic verification.
